examples.name: DUPR Gated Advanced Open Play 4.0+

examples.name: DUPR Logged Adv. Beginner Open Play 2.75+

Players should know the rules, keep the ball in play, and be working on shot consistency and court positioning.

Players can drill with their partner at their own pace or play games with other registered pairs when everyone agrees. No coach is on court, balls are available, and players should bring their paddle.

examples.name: Intermediate Open Play 3.25+
